explicit_amendment: The prior one-shot helper lifetime is replaced by one owned persistent worker with <=15 seconds aggregate active wall time, <=15 seconds cumulative worker CPU, and <=600 seconds idle-inclusive lifetime including cleanup. This does not establish native enforcement or expand the inherited experiment-wide limits.

resource_and_timing_contract.absolute_command_deadline: minimum of remaining active allowance, child launch+580, and every applicable inherited phase/work/post-ready deadline
resource_and_timing_contract.cleanup_deadline: minimum of failure+20, child launch+600, and inherited cleanup/lifecycle/outer deadline

native_audit_requirements: Bind the actual child interpreter/process identity and exact import/source closure. No policy execution in an unrelated process may be used to claim the 32 MiB helper pass.
Enforce independently supervised monotonic deadlines, cumulative active wall/CPU budgets and actual process RSS. The state-machine proposal alone is not enforcement.
Prove bounded pipe reads/writes and backpressure, strict frame validation, no concurrent commands/retries, and no unbounded wait or timeout reset.
Preserve original parent baseline object identity on abstention; bind prospective messages, source and preflight/measured receipts exactly.
Share the existing absolute cleanup reserve across owned processes; handle interruption and every error path, confirm exit and reaping, and leave no daemon.
Keep the helper free of HTTP, model/tokenizer calls, filesystem mutation, application imports and subprocess launches, including incidental interpreter behavior.
Retain only the authorized finite evidence. Do not export raw frames, source-bearing exceptions, environment or process dumps.
